dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters, INDEXED files, no EXEC SQL/CICS.
evidence: INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically inpatient (入院) diagnosis classification point aggregation for hospitalization receipts (入院・自費)
purpose.summary: ORCR0840 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that aggregates diagnosis classification points for inpatient (hospitalization) receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) representing receipt detail records, performing complex calculations for medical insurance billing including room charges, meal fees, rehabilitation counts, and special items.

notable_features: 41 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter
Multiple INDEXED files with both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
43 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
319 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Error file (RECEERR) for batch error reporting
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2003-2006
verdict.notes: File is 301KB with 6293 lines - a substantial production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding but were decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled display. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Filename prefix ORCR0840 follows ORCA naming conventions. The // REPLACING delimiter is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL used in the ORCA project.
